Class GameServerRemoteImpl

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
network.server.rmi.GameServerRemoteImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Remote, GameServerRemote
public class GameServerRemoteImpl extends UnicastRemoteObject implements GameServerRemote
RMI server endpoint (GameServerRemote implementation). Bridges RMI clients to the single LobbyManager: it registers players via the "ask" pattern, routes inbound ClientCommands, and dispatches heartbeats to the matching RmiVirtualView's liveness watchdog.

    • join

      public boolean join(String playerName, ClientCallbackRemote callback, String host) throws RemoteException
      Description copied from interface: GameServerRemote
      Registers a player with the server. Returns true when the name is accepted and the callback has been wired into the lobby; returns false when another client is already connected with the same name (the client may retry by calling join again with a different name on the same stub).
      Specified by:
      join in interface GameServerRemote
      Parameters:
      playerName - the requested player name
      callback - the client's exported callback for server→client messages
      host - the client's advertised host, used for logging
      Returns:
      true if the name was accepted, false if already taken
      Throws:
      RemoteException - on RMI transport failure

    • submitClientCommand

      public void submitClientCommand(ClientCommand command) throws RemoteException
      Accepts a command from the RMI client and dispatches it via the internal dispatcher. Any routing exception is wrapped in a RemoteException so the client receives a meaningful error.
      Specified by:
      submitClientCommand in interface GameServerRemote
      Parameters:
      command - the command to route
      Throws:
